# cvp_workspace_abandon (Action)

Abandon the workspace, discarding its pending changes (REQUEST_ABANDON).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Invoke the abandon verb on a workspace.
action "cvp_workspace_abandon" "example" {
  config {
    workspace_id = cvp_workspace.example.workspace_id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) The `workspace_id` of the target workspace.
